facts.end_use: hydrogen detection in equipment or facilities (not stated)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9027 covers instruments and apparatus for physical or chemical analysis, including gas analysis apparatus
Section XVI note 1(m) excludes articles of chapter 90 from heading 8543/8534, so the sensor module is not a general electrical article or bare printed circuit
Chapter 90 note 2(a): a part/module that is itself an instrument of a specific heading stays in that heading; the PCBA performs the gas-detection function itself

missing_facts: Does the PCBA itself contain the hydrogen sensing element and produce a concentration measurement, or is it a control board for a larger analyzer?
Does it only trigger an alarm without measuring (possible 8531)?
classification.rationale: A PCBA that carries a hydrogen sensor and electronics to measure gas concentration is itself an electrical gas analysis apparatus of heading 9027, and Section XVI note 1(m) keeps it out of chapter 85. HQ 967082 classified gas detectors with sensors measuring ppm of gas and displaying levels in 9027.10.20, separating mere alarms into 8531. If the board lacks the sensing element it would instead be a part in 9027.90.88.
